hook: A 6M-parameter model that copies your handwriting

beats.say: Sam Greydanus built PenGPT: a 6 million parameter transformer that writes print and cursive, and imitates a new writer from just a few of their words.
A second, 54 million parameter model draws sketches from text prompts. Both share one tokenizer that turns pen strokes into moves in eight directions.
The handwriting data covered 495,590 words by 1,255 writers, and the author says the work was 80 percent data.
